verdict.line: You lose if he chains Decimate into Crippling Strike and Apprehend before level 6; you win if you survive to Needlework range and he still has to walk through your Hallowed Mist to touch you.

brief.thesis: Darius's entire kill threat is a short-cooldown melee loop — Decimate (Q, 9s down to 5s cooldown) into Crippling Strike (W, flat 5s cooldown) stacking Hemorrhage toward the 5-stack enrage, then Apprehend (E) dragging you back in for a stack-scaled Noxian Guillotine. Gwen has no tool that out-trades him in a standing melee exchange before Needlework comes online at 6, so this matchup is won by denying extended trades and bleed stacks, not by fighting through them.

theirWindow.when: His Q and W are both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He'll walk up for a blade-side Decimate into Crippling Strike to slow and stack bleed fast; if Apprehend is also up he can pull you back in the moment you try to disengage, so don't start backing off until you've already created distance.

yourWindow.what: Snip Snip! cools down far faster than his Q (6.5s down to 3.5s vs his 9s down to 5s), so step up for a 450-range poke and dash back out with Skip 'n Slash before his swing is back — this is also your window to proactively drop Hallowed Mist, since he can't target you there without walking in and eating cooldown.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The extra sustain and mana keep you throwing Snip Snip! from range through early bleed trades instead of being forced into melee range to stay even on mana.

boots.why: Darius's threat is physical auto-attacks and an enraged max-stack bonus-AD swing; the flat reduction on repeated physical hits blunts both his poke and his all-in.

core.why: Highest-winrate opening item on this matchup's best path (59.8% over 214 games) and gives early burst to punish his cooldown windows.
Adds the burst amp that turns your Q poke and Needlework hits into real damage before he can stack Hemorrhage to enrage.
Caps the build out for maximum one-rotation burst once you're ahead of his melee range threat.

situational.when: he's ahead and threatening to all-in you with a stacked Hemorrhage into Noxian Guillotine
the game runs long and you need sustained damage in repeated skirmishes instead of one-shot burst
the enemy team builds magic resist to blunt your burst

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing let you win the war of attrition against his sustain from Decimate's heal instead of losing every extended trade outright.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his all-in commitment with guaranteed damage he can't heal back with Decimate, and Flash gives you an answer when Apprehend's 535-range pull drags you out of Hallowed Mist.

playing.title: Snipe, don't stand-trade
playing.detail: Poke with Snip Snip! from 450 range rather than standing in his melee Decimate/Crippling Strike range; every snip applies true damage and your passive without feeding his Hemorrhage stacks on you.

playing.title: Pop Mist before he commits
playing.detail: Drop Hallowed Mist while he's still walking up, not after he's already in range — he can only target you if he enters it, so he has to choose between wasting tempo or walking into your trade window.

playing.title: Dash out after every poke
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash partially refunds its cooldown when it lands, so firing it right after a Q poke both repositions you out of his melee threat and gets your dash back faster than his Crippling Strike comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Disengage before max stacks
playing.detail: Darius enrages for massive bonus AD at 5 Hemorrhage stacks — back off a trade before he reaches full stacks rather than contest the last auto, since the enrage swing plus a stack-scaled Noxian Guillotine can burst you from a healthy bar.

playing.title: Hold E as an Apprehend answer
playing.detail: His E hooks from 535 range and drags you to him; once he's level 3 and it's up, keep your dash available to reposition out of pull range rather than spending it purely for damage.

playing.title: Threaten with Needlework past 6
playing.detail: Once Needlework is up, its 1200 range and guaranteed passive application punish him for walking up without Decimate or Crippling Strike ready, so use it to deter his engage rather than only as a finisher.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability interactions, timing windows, and trade reasoning are my own tactical read, not sourced data.
